"""Validate documentation-only bounded closure against the completed Nix gate."""
import datetime
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path('/home/josh/projects/klem')
OUTPUT=ROOT/'docs/declarative-contrast-tracker-checks.json'
assert not OUTPUT.exists()
sha=lambda raw:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
combined_path=ROOT/'docs/declarative-contrast-combined-nix.json'
combined=json.loads(combined_path.read_text())
assert combined['state']=='passed' and combined['exit_code']==0
assert all(combined[k] is True for k in ['snapshot_unchanged','head_unchanged','staged_diff_unchanged'])
assert set(combined['expected_runtime_outputs'])<=set(combined['outputs']) and len(combined['outputs'])==4
combined_log=ROOT/'docs/declarative-contrast-combined-nix.log.gz'
assert sha(gzip.decompress(combined_log.read_bytes()))==combined['log_sha256']
changed={name for name,row in combined['snapshot']['files'].items() if sha((ROOT/name).read_bytes())!=row['sha256']}
expected={'docs/coverage-checklist.md','docs/rules.md','docs/inventory-reviews.json','docs/inventory-review-queue.json'}
assert changed==expected,changed
package=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/declarative-contrast-package-nix.json').read_text())
compile_files=package['snapshot']['files']
assert len(compile_files)==915 and all(sha((ROOT/name).read_bytes())==row['sha256'] for name,row in compile_files.items())
tracked_snapshot={name:{'sha256':sha((ROOT/name).read_bytes()),'bytes':(ROOT/name).stat().st_size} for name in expected}
commands=[['python3','tools/review_inventory.py','--verify'],['python3','-m','unittest','discover','-s','tools','-p','test_review_inventory.py'],['git','diff','--check'],['git','diff','--cached','--check']]
results=[]
for index,command in enumerate(commands):
    result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True)
    assert result.returncode==0,(command,result.stderr.decode())
    log_name='docs/declarative-contrast-tracker-'+('verify' if index==0 else 'controls')+'.log.gz' if index<2 else None
    if log_name:
        dest=ROOT/log_name;assert not dest.exists();dest.write_bytes(gzip.compress(result.stdout+result.stderr,mtime=0))
    results.append({'command':command,'exit_code':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout.decode(),'stderr':result.stderr.decode(),'log':log_name})
assert all(sha((ROOT/name).read_bytes())==row['sha256'] for name,row in tracked_snapshot.items())
queue=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/inventory-review-queue.json').read_text())
assert queue['counts']['by_review']=={'scoped':465,'unreviewed':250}
checklist=(ROOT/'docs/coverage-checklist.md').read_text()
assert '- [x] **COV-017ch' in checklist and '- [ ] **COV-017ci' in checklist
reviews=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/inventory-reviews.json').read_text())['entries']
selected=[e for e in reviews if e['id'] in {f'krdict:{i}' for i in range(80321,80327)}]
assert len(selected)==6 and all(e['status']=='scoped' and 'Final combined Nix inventory gate' not in e['remaining'] for e in selected)
producer=Path(__file__)
report={'schema_version':1,'state':'passed','exit_code':0,'finished_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        'combined_gate_sha256':sha(combined_path.read_bytes()),'combined_gate_outputs':combined['outputs'],
        'documentation_snapshot':tracked_snapshot,'documentation_inputs_unchanged':True,
        'changed_prior_tracked_files':sorted(changed),'all_other_2591_prior_tracked_files_unchanged':True,
        'tested_compile_frontend_files_unchanged':915,'commands':results,'inventory_counts':queue['counts'],
        'closed_checklist':'COV-017ch','source_reviews_closed_with_bounded_scope':[e['id'] for e in selected],
        'producer':{'text':producer.read_text(),'sha256':sha(producer.read_bytes())},
        'scope':'Terminal all-four-check Nix gate proves exact implementation/package/source audits. Subsequent changes are four documentation/review/queue files only; all915 compile/frontend files remain exact. Final regenerated queue verifier and nine integrity controls pass on the closed tracker, following its explicit documentation-only verification rule. No repeated application rebuild is required for this metadata-only closure. COV017ci and the full coverage goal,250 unreviewed inventory entries, broader composition, candidate precision, contextual/register and independent Korean review remain open.'}
OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Closed finite declarative contrast scope; nine tracker controls;915 tested compile/frontend files unchanged.',flush=True)
